moveEvidence.speaker: James White
moveEvidence.claim: The earliest witnesses display multiple intersecting transmission lines rather than one centrally edited chain.
moveEvidence.warrant: White says varied lines and the absence of a controlling editor make coordinated wholesale alteration less plausible.
moveEvidence.inference: Distributed transmission supplies independent comparative evidence for reconstruction.
